description: Search spans — Search spans with structured JSON filters — the programmatic form of the `filter` string DSL on `GET /v1/spans`. `filters` is an AND-list of predicates (`{field, operator, value}`) and one-level OR-groups (`{or: [...]}`). Adds membership operators `in`, `notIn`, and `between`. Valid fields and operators are machine-readable at `GET /v1/filter-schema`. Defaults to the last 7 days when `start_date` is unset; the maximum search window is 90 days.
name: search_spans
